Never retry an invoice that has a refund in progress.","physical":["src/billing/dunning.py"],"logical":["billing.dunning"],"tags":["billing","payments","dunning"],"criticality":0.5,"confidence":0.8,"status":"active","visibility":"shared","provenance":"human","epistemic":"decision"}

A failed charge is retried four times, on days 1, 3, 7 and 14 after the failure. The schedule is contractual (finance policy FP-12).

- If the day-14 retry also fails, the invoice is marked `uncollectible` and retries stop.
- An invoice with a refund in progress is never retried.

This comes from a stored project decision, not from the code. The memory points at `src/billing/dunning.py`, and I haven't opened that file, so I can't say whether the implementation matches the policy.
